verdicts.reason: A has the right banner order: Solstice logo, product, headline, then CTA. But the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk to an unreadable sticker crammed against the subcopy and CTA, the headline's 'last' nearly touches the CTA button, and the legal text sits in the brand slot at the far left at a size no one could read. B has the same tiny, colliding ribbon and headline-to-CTA crowding, and it is worse because it puts the fine print in the lead position while the logo shrinks to a near-invisible mark tucked under the product, so the brand is effectively lost.
